title: 第一卷 第11章 恭送小师叔第一卷 第12章 要处处超过她
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
苏明月微微一愣。
意识到云爻竟然在帮洛还真说话之后，她原本还有些荡漾的心情一下子变得无语。
这个男人到底是怎么回事？
明明自己已经先道歉和示弱了，他居然一点都不同情和怜爱自己。
雷子越磕磕绊绊道：“师、师叔祖，我们不是这个意思……”
衡阳子没说话。
在晚辈面前，他擅长和稀泥；在长辈面前，他擅长装孙子。
但是他不说话，云爻却不打算就这么放过他。
素净出尘的青衫青年敲了敲桌子，慢吞吞点名：“师侄啊，你打算怎么处理？”
衡阳子冷汗都下来了。
他打算怎么处理？他就打算根据二弟子雷子越说的方式处理。
简单粗暴还省事儿。
都怪洛还真非要闹，还惊动了师叔……
于是衡阳子低声下气道：“真真是我真正的弟子，自然是要将她本来的名分都交还给她，至于明月，我会收她做第七个弟子。”
“师尊。”
苏明月突然弱弱开口，“一个炼气期的弟子，手里拿着魔族的法器。是，我们是不对，但真真师姐又何尝没错呢！她今日敢催动魔物对师尊出手，他日便敢对别的无辜修士出手。那般可怖的杀器在她手中，明月觉得不合适。”
衡阳子本来就对洛还真手里这法器忌惮不已，刚才要不是这法器，他何至于惩治不了一个区区炼气期的小毛孩子。
此时听见苏明月的话，他便捋着胡须点头：“此言有理。真真，这东西你拿着不合适。”
苏明月一副我是为你好的表情看向洛还真，“是啊，真真师姐，你手中那旗子更适合交给心智包容平和，为人温和的弟子，免得他日因你的鲁莽和冲动，酿成大祸。”
这样强大的法器，怎么会落在洛还真这个丑陋肮脏的小鬼身上。

要是她的该多好。
洛还真虽然不谙人心的弯弯绕绕，但也看出来这个大姐姐想要她的小旗子。
她眨巴着眼睛，“好哇，本尊交出小旗子。给谁呢，给你好不好？”
苏明月咬唇轻声道：“我先代为拿着，等师尊定夺真正的接管者我便给他们。”
然而，她的手才触到小旗子，便感觉到一股可怖的魔压顺着小旗杆钻入她的身体。
那是一种她完全无法承受的痛苦。
“啊！！！”
苏明月瞬间丢掉小旗子，整个人缩回丹红长老的怀里，浑身发白，面露惊恐。
洛还真拍着小短手，咯咯咯地笑。
她的小旗子力量霸道，可不是什么人都能拿的。
“叫你们贪心！还有，不许叫本尊师姐，本尊才不当你的师姐了，本尊要走。”
说罢，洛还真勾勾手指，万魔幡重新飞回到她的小揪揪上。
她支棱起两条小短腿，，便要从桌子上爬下来。
她回玄天宗，是因为这里是她的家，有爱她的师尊和师兄们。
但是现在，她不要师尊和师兄们了。
她并不想留在玄天宗。
content_en:
Su Mingyue was slightly startled.
After realizing that Yun Yao was actually helping Luo Huanzhen speak, her originally agitated mood suddenly became speechless.
What is going on with this man?
Even though he had apologized and shown weakness first, he actually showed no sympathy or love for him at all.
Lei Ziyue stumbled and said: "Master, Master, uncle, that's not what we meant..."
Hengyangzi said nothing.
In front of the younger generation, he is good at being friendly; in front of the elders, he is good at pretending to be a grandson.
But he didn't speak, but Yun Yao didn't intend to let him go just like that.
The pure young man in green shirt knocked on the table and called his name slowly: "Master nephew, how do you plan to deal with it?"
Hengyangzi broke into a cold sweat.
How is he going to deal with it? He planned to deal with it according to what his second disciple Lei Ziyue said.
It's simple, crude and trouble-free.
It's all because Luo Huanzhen insisted on making trouble and alerted his uncle...
So Hengyangzi said in a low voice: "She is my true disciple. Naturally, I want to return her original status to her. As for Mingyue, I will accept her as my seventh disciple."
"Master."
Su Mingyue suddenly spoke weakly, "A disciple in the Qi refining stage holds a magic weapon of the demon clan in his hand. Yes, we are wrong, but senior sister Zhenzhen is not right! She dared to activate the monster to attack the master today, and she will dare to attack other innocent monks in the future. Mingyue feels it is inappropriate to have such a terrifying murder weapon in her hands."
Hengyangzi was originally very afraid of the magical weapon in Luo Huanzhen's hand. If it hadn't been for this magical weapon just now, why wouldn't he be able to punish a mere kid in the Qi refining stage.
When he heard Su Mingyue's words, he stroked his beard and nodded: "That makes sense. Really, it's not appropriate for you to hold this thing."
Su Mingyue looked at Luo Huanzhen with an expression of "I am doing it for you", "Yes, Senior Sister Zhenzhen, the flag in your hand is more suitable to be given to a disciple who is tolerant, peaceful and gentle, so as not to cause a big disaster in the future due to your recklessness and impulsiveness."
How could such a powerful magic weapon fall into the hands of an ugly and dirty brat like Luo Huanzhen.
If only it were hers.
Although Luo Huanzhen didn't understand people's twists and turns, he could still see that this big sister wanted her little flag.
She blinked, "Okay, I hand over the little flag. Who is it for? Can I give it to you?"
Su Mingyue bit her lip and said softly: "I will hold it for you first, and I will give it to them when Master decides on the real successor."
However, just as her hand touched the small flag, she felt a terrifying magical pressure penetrate into her body along the small flagpole.
It was a kind of pain that she couldn't bear at all.
"Ah!!!"
Su Mingyue threw away the little flag in an instant and retreated into Elder Danhong's arms, her whole body turned white and her face looked frightened.
Luo Huazhen clapped his short hands and giggled.
Her little flag is so powerful that not just anyone can take it.
"I call you greedy! Also, don't call me senior sister. I don't want to be your senior sister anymore. I want to leave."
After saying that, Luo Hua really hooked her fingers, and the Ten Thousand Demon Flags flew back to her little one.
She stretched out her short legs and climbed down from the table.
She returned to Xuantian Sect because this was her home and she had a master and senior brothers who loved her.
But now, she no longer wants her master and senior brothers.
She didn't want to stay in Xuantian Sect.
